tools.name: load_more_job_cards
tools.description: Fetch the next page of Job Cards for the current search (cursor + same filters as the initial search_jobs). Used by the Job Cards widget when the swipe deck runs low. Do not call from the model.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed information about a specific job, including full responsibilities, qualifications, and company details. Use this after search_jobs or get_recent_jobs when a user wants to know more about a particular job. Requires the job's ID from a previous search result.

tools.name: get_job_keywords

tools.description: Returns aggregate statistics about the current job market as indexed by Worklittle. Use this when a user asks broad questions like 'what jobs are available?', 'how many remote jobs are there?', 'which companies are hiring the most?', or 'what does the job market look like overall?'. tools.name: track_applied_job
tools.description: Record that the API key owner saved, applied to, clicked Apply, or skipped a job. Use status saved for heart/save and skipped for deck Skip. Defaults to in_progress (apply / apply_with_ai) or applied (api).

tools.name: delete_applied_job
tools.description: Remove a job from the API key owner's personal saved-jobs pipeline (unheart / remove from Saved).

tools.name: get_connected_account
tools.description: Return the user_id, email, display name, photo, resume readiness, full Settings profile fields, and email_prefs of the API key / OAuth account connected to this MCP session. tools.name: mint_mcp_ui_embed_session
tools.description: Mint a one-time short-lived enter URL so the Job Cards iframe can open the live worklittle.com consumer app signed in as the connected account. Widget-only.

tools.name: mint_chatgpt_embed_session
tools.description: Mint a one-time short-lived enter URL so the Job Cards iframe can open the live worklittle.com consumer app signed in as the connected account. Widget-only.

tools.name: get_maps_api_key
tools.description: Return a Google Maps JavaScript API key for the Job Cards in-app Maps tab. Widget-only; not for the model.

tools.name: logout_connected_account
tools.description: Log out of the Worklittle account linked to this MCP Connect session without removing the ChatGPT/Claude app. Revokes the connector token so the next Apply re-prompts Connect (use this instead of Disconnect). Job Cards overflow Log out.

tools.name: upload_profile_resume
tools.description: Upload the connected account's profile resume file (PDF, Word, text, or image). Used by Job Cards Apply resume gate before start_apply_with_ai. Requires jobs:apply.

tools.name: get_profile_resume_status
tools.description: Poll profile resume processing status after upload_profile_resume (ready | processing | idle | missing). Job Cards analyzing phase.

tools.name: remove_profile_resume
tools.description: Delete the connected account's profile resume file. Used by Job Cards You/Settings. Requires jobs:apply.

tools.name: update_connected_profile
tools.description: Patch the connected account's Settings profile fields (name, school, desired role, phone, links, work authorization, driver's license, interests). Used by Job Cards You overlay. Requires jobs:apply. Syncs to cloud for worklittle.com.

tools.name: update_connected_email_prefs
tools.description: Update connected account email and privacy prefs (job_alerts, local_events, announcements, marketing_measurement, personalized_marketing). Job Cards You overlay. Requires jobs:apply.

tools.name: remove_connected_profile_photo
tools.description: Remove the connected account's uploaded profile photo and reset to a default avatar. Job Cards You overlay. Requires jobs:apply.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.worklittle.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_connected_account, mint_mcp_ui_embed_session, mint_chatgpt_embed_session, start_apply_with_ai · Private data: search_jobs, track_applied_job, delete_applied_job, get_connected_account, get_maps_api_key, logout_connected_account, upload_profile_resume, remove_profile_resume, start_apply_with_ai · Public sink: get_connected_account, upload_profile_resume, update_connected_email_prefs, start_apply_with_ai · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_applied_job, remove_profile_resume, remove_connected_profile_photo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_connected_account, mint_mcp_ui_embed_session, mint_chatgpt_embed_session, start_apply_with_ai · Private data: search_jobs, track_applied_job, delete_applied_job, get_connected_account, get_maps_api_key, logout_connected_account, upload_profile_resume, remove_profile_resume, start_apply_with_ai · Public sink: get_connected_account, upload_profile_resume, update_connected_email_prefs, start_apply_with_ai · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_applied_job, remove_profile_resume, remove_connected_profile_photo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
